text:
Elliot Price: pulling together the troubleshooting page for Quickstart Templates. can folks drop the top onboarding/template failures we’re seeing (support + #help) + any specific error strings? trying to keep it scoped to “things users hit in first 30 mins.”

Wei Chen: +1. If you have repro steps, even better. I’m drafting sections like Auth / Rate limits / Streaming / OTel / Retrieval / Tool calling.

Priya Shah: top 3 from support last 2 weeks:
1) 401/403 due to missing/incorrect `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (users set `OPENAI_API_KEY` out of habit)
2) 429s from default concurrency (template runs multiple requests in parallel during eval + warmup)
3) OTel exporter misconfigured (endpoint/auth) → “collector unreachable” / “401 from exporter”

Dev Patel: adding specifics:
- 401: “Unauthorized: invalid API key” or “missing authorization header”
- 403: “Project not allowed to access model” (usually they copied model name from docs but aren’t in allowlist / wrong region)
- 429: “rate_limit_exceeded” w/ retry-after header; users behind workers/queues need guidance

Renee Sullivan: from #help:
- macOS python install fails (Rust build / `pip` compiling something) — they try `pip install -r requirements.txt` and get `error: can't find Rust compiler` or `Failed building wheel`
- confusion about `.env` vs shell env vars; they run `uvicorn` in a different shell and key isn’t loaded

Monica Patel: common w/ templates using OpenAI-compat:
- users set `BASE_URL` wrong (missing `/v1`), then they get 404 on `POST /chat/completions`
- also “model not found” because they didn’t set `REDWOOD_MODEL` and template default points to a model they don’t have access to yet

Dana Lo: TS template issues:
- Node fetch streaming: users see `TypeError: terminated` / `UND_ERR_SOCKET` when proxy closes idle connection
- they run on Vercel/Next and forget to disable response buffering → stream appears “stuck” then completes all at once
- also ESM/CJS mismatch when using older node (18.16) + tsconfig settings; error: `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`

Wei Chen: for the page, can we standardize on “symptom → likely cause → fix” patterns? especially for env-var confusion.

Allison Grant: observability pain points:
- local collector not receiving traces: they start app but forget `docker compose up otel-collector`
- wrong endpoint var: set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317` but their exporter uses http/protobuf on 4318
- cardinality footgun: they turn on debug logging and start logging prompts; we should explicitly say “don’t log prompts/PII” + show redaction config

Sergio Costa: + one more: users expect metrics in Console but they’re only sending OTel locally. Need a “how to verify telemetry locally” section:
- check collector logs
- check `http://localhost:13133/healthz` if enabled
- sample `curl` to hit app and confirm `trace_id` shows up in logs

Priya Shah: specific ticket refs we should mirror (not linking externally, but the issues):
- SUP-29410 streaming disconnects behind corp proxy
- SUP-29422 OTel exporter auth failing
- SUP-29435 template defaults trigger 429
- SUP-29441 agent tool schema parse error
- SUP-29458 telemetry header blocked by proxy

Dev Patel: telemetry header one is important. Some corporate proxies reject unknown headers → app gets 4xx before reaching us. In the template we made telemetry tags opt-in, but docs should say:
- if you see 400/431-ish from proxy, disable template telemetry header (env var)
- alternative: add header to proxy allowlist

Elliot Price: yep. can someone paste the exact env var name we landed on for “disable template telemetry”?

Monica Patel: in python template it’s `REDWOOD_TEMPLATE_TELEMETRY=0` (or unset). we also support `REDWOOD_TEMPLATE_TAG=<string>` when enabled.

Dana Lo: TS mirrors that. We default to disabled now after the proxy reports. When enabled we send `x-redwood-template` (value is template id + version). (gateway allows only a small whitelist)

Wei Chen: great—i’ll write it as: “If requests fail only on corp network, try disabling template telemetry header and retry.”

Renee Sullivan: RAG-specific failures:
- retrieval returns empty because user didn’t run ingest step (they go straight to chat endpoint)
- wrong file paths (running from repo root vs template dir)
- chunking defaults too big/small → results look irrelevant → they think model is “bad” (we should put a quick sanity checklist)

Priya Shah: +1. We see “it returns ‘I don’t know’ every time” and it’s because the vector index is empty. Error isn’t always thrown; it’s “0 documents retrieved.” We should have template log line like `retrieval.num_docs=0` and mention it in troubleshooting.

Allison Grant: if we already emit `retrieval.docs_returned` metric, call it out. Also recommend a log field `retrieval.query_hash` (not the raw query) so support can correlate without PII.

Dev Patel: agent/tool calling:
- schema validation errors are common. User adds a tool and returns wrong JSON shape → template throws “tool schema validation failed”
- also tool output too large (we cap tool output size) → error: “tool_output_too_large”

Wei Chen: can someone drop the exact phrasing the template uses for tool schema errors? want to match for searchability.

Dana Lo: TS error message currently: `ToolResultValidationError: tool '<name>' returned invalid payload (expected <schema>)`. We also log `error.type=tool_validation` and include `tool.name`.

Monica Patel: python: `ToolValidationError: invalid tool output` + in logs `tool.name`, `tool.call_id`, `tool.validation_error` (string) and a redacted preview.

Elliot Price: perfect. also anything around timeouts/retries? users might be confused by “why is it retrying so much.”

Sergio Costa: we’ve seen reports of “app hangs for ~60s” when upstream is slow; it’s retries + exponential backoff + per-request timeout. docs should explain:
- default timeout per attempt
- max retries
- how to lower retries for interactive UX vs increase for batch

Priya Shah: + add a short “when to contact support” section: include `x-redwood-request-id` and trace id from logs; don’t paste prompts if sensitive.

Renee Sullivan: from #help, people paste full prompts in screenshots. We should explicitly tell them “share request id + error type + timestamps” instead.

Wei Chen: awesome. I’ll draft with these headings:
- Auth & keys (401/403)
- Model config (404/model not found)
- Rate limits (429) + tuning concurrency
- Streaming disconnects (proxies, buffering)
- Telemetry headers blocked (opt-in tag)
- OTel collector/exporter setup
- RAG ingestion/retrieval empty
- Tool schema validation + tool output size caps
- Install/runtime (macOS wheels, node versions)

Elliot Price: thanks all. I’ll turn this into a checklist-y page + make sure it’s consistent with the README troubleshooting sections. Wei — ping me when draft is up and I’ll review for tone/IA.
